The tracking information for a shipment.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|tracking_number|string|true|none|The tracking number for the shipment. This property supports Unicode.|
|carrier|[shipment_carrier](#schemashipment_carrier)|true|none|The carrier for the shipment. Some carriers have a global version as well as local subsidiaries. The subsidiaries are repeated over many countries and might also have an entry in the global list. Choose the carrier for your country. If the carrier is not available for your country, choose the global version of the carrier. If your carrier name is not in the list, set `carrier` to `OTHER` and set carrier name in `carrier_name_other`. For allowed values, see <a href="/docs/tracking/reference/carriers/">Carriers</a>.|
|carrier_name_other|string|false|none|The name of the carrier for the shipment. Provide this value only if the carrier parameter is OTHER. This property supports Unicode.|

<h2 id="tocS_order_tracker_request">order_tracker_request</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaorder_tracker_request"></a>
<a id="schema_order_tracker_request"></a>
<a id="tocSorder_tracker_request"></a>
<a id="tocsorder_tracker_request"></a>

```json
{
  "tracking_number": "string",
  "carrier": "DPD_RU",
  "carrier_name_other": "string",
  "capture_id": "string",
  "notify_payer": false,
  "items": [
    {
      "name": "string",
      "quantity": "string",
      "sku": "string",
      "url": "http://example.com",
      "image_url": "http://example.com",
      "upc": {
        "type": "UPC-A",
        "code": "string"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

The tracking details of an order.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|tracking_number|string|true|none|The tracking number for the shipment. This property supports Unicode.|
|carrier|[shipment_carrier](#schemashipment_carrier)|true|none|The carrier for the shipment. Some carriers have a global version as well as local subsidiaries. The subsidiaries are repeated over many countries and might also have an entry in the global list. Choose the carrier for your country. If the carrier is not available for your country, choose the global version of the carrier. If your carrier name is not in the list, set `carrier` to `OTHER` and set carrier name in `carrier_name_other`. For allowed values, see <a href="/docs/tracking/reference/carriers/">Carriers</a>.|
|carrier_name_other|string|false|none|The name of the carrier for the shipment. Provide this value only if the carrier parameter is OTHER. This property supports Unicode.|
|capture_id|string|true|none|The PayPal capture ID.|
|notify_payer|boolean|false|none|If true, PayPal will send an email notification to the payer of the PayPal transaction. The email contains the tracking details provided through the Orders tracking API request. Independent of any value passed for `notify_payer`, the payer may receive tracking notifications within the PayPal app, based on the user's notification preferences.|
|items|[object]|false|none|An array of details of items in the shipment.|

Shipping Options Callback request. This will be implemented by the merchants.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|read-only|The ID of the order.|
|shipping_address|object|false|none|none|
|shipping_option|object|false|none|none|
|purchase_units|[object]|true|none|An array of purchase units. At present only 1 purchase_unit is supported. Each purchase unit establishes a contract between a payer and the payee. Each purchase unit represents either a full or partial order that the payer intends to purchase from the payee.|

The error details. Required for client-side `4XX` errors.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|field|string|false|none|The field that caused the error. If this field is in the body, set this value to the field's JSON pointer value. Required for client-side errors.|
|value|string|false|none|The value of the field that caused the error.|
|issue|string|true|none|The unique, fine-grained application-level error code.|
